content: In his R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat, a short commentary on Q 54:1 (The Hour has drawn nigh: the moon is split), Ibn Turka gives seven different interpretations of the verse, each tied to a group of increasing sophistication. Melvin-Koushki calls this seven-tiered intellectual hierarchy the key to Ibn Turka's thought and to that of the Neo-Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ generally.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
